candidates.title: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Directly matches the repository's highest-priority SSD/NVMe offload theme. Tutti replaces CPU-centric SSD KV-cache I/O with a GPU-centric object/I/O path, integrates with vLLM, and reports 78.3% TTFT reduction, 2x achievable request rate, and 27% serving-cost reduction versus GDS-enabled SSD-backed LMCache.

candidates.title: SwiftCache: Efficient LLM Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with Heterogeneous KV Cache Sharing
candidates.reason: Strong heterogeneous-memory KV-cache systems work. It borrows otherwise-idle HBM from co-located models over NVLink and keeps only the active layer's KV locally, reporting up to 69% lower P99 TTFT and 3.98x longer supported context.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Candidate inventory was below the critical watermark, so discovery was prioritized. Searched recent primary-source LLM serving work around SSD-backed KV cache, heterogeneous KV placement, offload, and long-context serving. Two strong candidates survived repository code-search pre-dedupe.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Rotate next toward OS paging/GPU virtual memory, storage I/O scheduling, or network-aware KV transport instead of repeating SSD-KV queries if these are accepted.
